summary:
I fixed the blocker, both major issues and all but one of the 14 minor issues in packages/extension and packages/webview. The one left is the junction dot, deferred and listed under open issues. Every affected suite passes: webview 83 unit tests and 47 Playwright tests, extension 92 unit tests, and the VS Code smoke run (30 passing) plus the e2e run (12 passing, real Lean and git) with no isolation failures.

**Blocker (board blank after reload/restart).** Two changes, either of which alone breaks the wait. (1) `restoreBoard` now resolves as soon as the restored panel has the board's HTML; the model session attaches in the background (`host.ts`: new `showBoard`, which `openBoard` awaits and `restoreBoard` does not). (2) `BoardPanel.post` never waits for `webview.postMessage` to resolve; delivery is only logged and reported through `onDidPostToBoard`. A new unit test (`hostRestore.test.ts`, with a vitest stand-in for `vscode` in `vscodeStub.ts`) uses fake panels whose `postMessage` never resolves. Against the old behaviour it fails 4 of 5; with the fix it passes 5 of 5. I also checked it for real in an isolated VS Code 1.140 instance: after a restart and after two "Developer: Reload Window" rounds, both restored boards render 4 cards each (6/6 checks). The extension log now shows the full sequence, including the webview's "ready".

**Major.**
- **Toast Undo:** only the newest undoable toast offers Undo, and only while the host's Undo label equals that toast's text. Any Undo or Redo removes the button from every toast. At most three toasts show, at the bottom right of the board area, never over the tray or the A|D|G box.
- **Narrow board:** columns keep at least 220 px and the board scrolls sideways; the arrows stay correct while it scrolls. Words no longer break inside (`break-word` instead of `anywhere`), and the "uses:" line wraps instead of being cut. "Open in editor" uses another editor group when one exists and splits the board's group only when it is the only one. In real VS Code this gave 220 px columns, sideways scrolling and no broken words.

**Minor.**
- **Keyboard:** opening a dropdown moves focus into it. Up/Down/Home/End move between items, Tab past the ends leaves it, and Escape or choosing an item returns focus to its button. Saving or cancelling an inline edit returns focus to the card. The Delete dialog focuses Cancel. Alt+Up/Down re-orders the focused card.
- **History:** the listing reloads while the dropdown is open when history becomes ready (e.g. right after "Initialize git"). "Keep last N" asks first ("Drop 1 older snapshot of Spyro? This cannot be undone.") and is disabled when there is nothing to drop.
- **Files changed outside VS Code:** a Lean file written by another program now triggers a Lean refresh. Dirty editors, telelean's own writes and echoes of the user's saves are ignored. In real VS Code the badge returned to "up to date" after about 2 s. The stale chip now reads "changed since last check", and "checking…" only while Lean is actually checking.
- **Highlight:** an outline plus a 16 % tint and a halo, so the item's text keeps its colour.
- **Arrows:** a focused arrow that skips the Derivations column is routed through a gap between Derivation cards (and around the empty-column placeholder); unfocused ones still run under the cards.
- **Backticks:** spans from core render as `<code>` in visible text and are stripped in tooltips. The Lean badge tooltip is joined as proper sentences ("…threshold. Click to check again.").
- **History preview:** short tab title such as `History: <label> (14:03)`, opened beside the board, never over it.
- **Empty board:** points to the A|D|G box.
- **"These suffice":** names the declared premises it would drop and offers "Add to its premises".
- **Save failure:** "applied but not saved" now counts as applied, so it is recorded for Undo, snapshotted and re-read, and VS Code shows a warning to save the file.
- **Non-atomic applyEdit:** the files to be edited are opened before the check, so VS Code's own version check covers the edit. A batch VS Code applied only in part is changed back, or the error names exactly which files are left changed.

I also fixed a small existing bug in the file-watcher batching (`some` with a side-effecting delete left later paths behind).

resolved: BLOCKER (extension) restored board stays blank: `restoreBoard` no longer awaits the session; `BoardPanel.post` never awaits delivery. Covered by the new hostRestore unit test (fails 4/5 on the old code) and a real restart plus 2-reload check (6/6 PASS).

MAJOR (webview) toast Undo undoes a different action: Undo shows only on the newest undoable toast while `workspace.undo` equals its label, and any Undo or Redo clears it everywhere (`toastCanUndo`, store, Toasts.tsx). Store unit test and Playwright AT6.10 updated.

MAJOR (webview) board unreadable below ~600 px: columns keep at least 220 px with sideways scrolling, the gap narrows to 40 px under 860 px, `overflow-wrap: break-word`, and the uses line wraps. 'Open in editor' prefers an existing other editor group (`groupBesideBoard`). Playwright narrow-board test and a real-VS-Code check (columns [220,220,220], no broken words).

MINOR keyboard: dropdowns take the focus (checked or first menu item, else the dropdown itself), Up/Down/Home/End move between items, Tab and Shift+Tab leave past the ends, focus returns to the button on close; inline edits return focus to the card; the Delete dialog focuses Cancel; Alt+Up/Down re-orders cards (`moveCard`).
MINOR History: listing re-requested while open when history becomes ready (and on subject or undo/redo change); 'Keep last N' asks with a count and is disabled when nothing would be dropped.

MINOR extension: outside writes to Lean files trigger `requestRefresh('files')`, ignoring dirty editors, telelean's own writes and echoes of user saves. Stale chip renamed 'changed since last check' ('checking…' only while Lean checks). Suite test extended; real VS Code check passed.
MINOR highlight unreadable: outline, 16% tint and halo instead of an opaque fill (board.css).

MINOR focused arrows strike through cards: focused A↔G arrows are routed through a gap in the Derivations column; the empty-column placeholder also counts as an obstacle (`gutterY`, `routedPath`, EdgeEngine obstacles). Unit and Playwright tests.
MINOR toasts over the tray: toasts sit in the board area (`.tl-main`), at most 3.
MINOR literal backticks and run-together tooltip: `InlineCode` renders <code> spans, `plainText` strips them in titles, `sentences` joins the badge tooltip properly.
MINOR history preview title and placement: title 'History: <label cut at 40> (<time>)[ vs now]'; the preview opens in another group, or a new second group, so it never covers the board.
MINOR empty board gives no first step: a first-step hint in the tray and the Assumptions placeholder ('No assumptions yet: type your first one in the box below').
MINOR 'These suffice' silently replaces premises: the tray names the premises it would drop and offers 'Add to its premises' (`theseSuffice('add')` posts the union).
MINOR applied-but-not-saved: the applier now resolves (the runner records Undo, snapshots and re-reads) and calls `onUnsaved`; VS Code shows a warning to save the file.

MINOR applyEdit not atomic: touched documents are opened before the check (`prepare`), so VS Code's version check covers the edit; a partly applied batch is reverted, or the error names the files left changed. Unit tests for both paths.
Extra: fixed an existing watcher-batch bug (`some` with a side-effecting delete left later paths in refreshPaths).

minor_decisions.decision: The restore fix has two layers: the serializer resolves as soon as the panel has its HTML, and posts never wait for delivery.
minor_decisions.rationale: Either one breaks the wait-for-each-other deadlock. Non-blocking posts also stop 'Open Board' from hanging when a new webview never loads (the integrator's unexplained smoke race).

minor_decisions.decision: TeleleanApi.onDidPostToBoard now fires when VS Code reports delivery, and tests wait for events instead of assuming their order.
minor_decisions.rationale: Delivery is only known asynchronously once posts stop waiting for it. Two suite tests were adjusted accordingly.

minor_decisions.decision: A toast's Undo button needs the toast to be the newest undoable one, its label to equal workspace.undo, and no Undo or Redo since. At most 3 toasts, placed in the board area.
minor_decisions.rationale: The protocol's undo names no action, so this is the only safe way to make toast Undo mean 'undo this'.

minor_decisions.decision: Minimum column width 220 px with a horizontally scrolling board, and a 40 px gutter under an 860 px viewport, instead of a stacked or tabbed layout.
minor_decisions.rationale: The edge engine assumes three side-by-side columns. Sideways scrolling keeps every arrow correct (tested) with little code.

minor_decisions.decision: 'Open in editor' and the history preview use an existing other editor group (one already showing the file first) and split the board's group only when it is the only one. The multi-file diff is placed by focusing that group first (`workbench.action.focus<Nth>EditorGroup`).
minor_decisions.rationale: `vscode.changes` takes no view column; this never covers the board and splits it at most once.

minor_decisions.decision: Lean files written by other programs trigger a Lean refresh, while echoes of the user's own saves are ignored so a save does not refresh twice.
minor_decisions.rationale: Such a write is a save by another program. Otherwise cards stayed 'changed since last check' until the next save or Refresh. The refresh still runs only while the board is open (D-28).

minor_decisions.decision: The stale chip reads 'changed since last check'; 'checking…' appears only while semantic.state is 'checking'.
minor_decisions.rationale: The chip and the badge no longer use the same word for different things.

minor_decisions.decision: Only focused arrows that skip the Derivations column are routed through a gap there; unfocused ones stay under the cards, as before.
minor_decisions.rationale: A focused arrow can be traced without striking through text, while background arrows add no new clutter.

minor_decisions.decision: 'These suffice' keeps D-13's replace semantics as the default; the tray names what it drops and adds an 'Add to its premises' button that posts the union.
minor_decisions.rationale: Follows the review's suggested fix with no protocol change.

minor_decisions.decision: History pruning is confirmed inline in the dropdown rather than in a modal.
minor_decisions.rationale: The updated listing and storage counter stay visible after pruning.

minor_decisions.decision: When a dropdown opens, focus goes to its checked or first menu item, otherwise to the dropdown itself. Tab past the last item moves to the control after the button, as if the dropdown sat there in the page.
minor_decisions.rationale: The dropdowns are rendered at the end of <body>, so without this Tab and arrows went to the wrong places.

minor_decisions.decision: Applied-but-unsaved is treated as success plus a warning, and a partly applied batch is reverted.
minor_decisions.rationale: The runner's contract assumes all-or-nothing and records nothing when apply throws. Throwing after a partial apply left changes nobody could undo.
